transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I've been feeling extremely depressed and constantly exhausted for the past five months. I've completely lost all interest and motivation in my daily life, and I just don't know what to do anymore.
Have you ever had periods lasting at least a few days where you felt the exact opposite—unusually energetic, happy, or hyperactive, and needed much less sleep than usual?

Yes, before this depression started, I had a period of about three months where I felt the exact opposite. I had an incredible overflow of physical and mental energy, feeling unusually happy and elevated all the time. I was extremely hyperactive and constantly on the move, doing far more than I normally would.

During those three months of high energy, did your behavior cause severe disruption in your life or lead to a hospital stay, or did you experience things like hearing voices or having beliefs others found unrealistic?

Yes, during those three months, I heard voices that weren't actually there and truly believed I was being monitored and had special abilities. Those strange experiences only happened during that high-energy period and went away completely once my mood crashed.
